name: navbar-menu
blurb: Composable navbar with hover-triggered dropdown menus and smooth animations.
description: Exports four composable components: Menu (container), MenuItem (triggers), ProductItem (card grid), and HoveredLink (text link). Uses Framer Motion for dropdown scale and fade animations triggered on mouse enter.
use_when: Building a premium navigation header with dropdown product showcases or multi-level menu structures that need fine-grained animation control.
avoid_when: Mobile navigation; hover-based menus are poor for touch. Keyboard navigation not supported.
a11y: No ARIA attributes or keyboard handling. Focus and semantic structure not managed by the component.
